correctness.rationale: The scripts reconstruct all 56 exceptional-curve labels and their intersection-one matrix exactly over Z[t]/(t^4+1), certify all four Frobenius permutations as graph automorphisms, derive integral coinvariant relations including the additional 2-torsion generator for free involutions, and compute full p-local Smith valuations. The trivial action reproduces the known full graph critical group; invariant monodromy pairing identifies dual of coinvariants with fixed points. No finite experiment is used to justify an infinite family without the q modulo eight Galois action proof.

value.rationale: Full arithmetic descent of the 56-curve graph's integral critical group is a natural invariant of a distinguished del Pezzo surface. Unlike the known geometric critical group or Picard action separately, the new four-case classification distinguishes Frobenius classes with identical vertex-orbit lengths and determines all primary components, supporting arithmetic incidence comparisons over extensions.
